title: 第1047章 皇天宫一第1046章 出发万道星海
content_zh:
时间一天天过去。
足足在虚空之中穿梭了两个月有余。
前方的星光开始呈现出一种隐隐泛红的色调。
飞剑又飞行了半日，当从一处虚空裂缝之中跳跃而出时，前方忽然豁然开朗。
无边无际的星空之内，一座座星界群横亘在虚空之中，数不清的星辰汇聚成一片璀璨的光海，光海中央有一条巨大的星河盘旋蜿蜒，如同一条银白色的巨龙盘卧在虚空之中。
而那星河的每一道支流、每一座大小星界的边缘，都缠绕着一圈瑰丽至极的红色光环！
那红色既非火焰的赤红，也非血色的暗红，而更像是是一种剔透如水晶、明亮如朝霞的灿红色。每一道光环都均匀地环绕星界运转，表面流淌着细密的金色纹路，如同有生命的脉络在缓缓搏动！
成千上万座星界，每一座都套着这样一圈红环，远远望去，整片星海像是被织上了一张巨大的红色光网，那些光环在漆黑的虚空中交错辉映，将方圆万万里的虚空路都染上了一层柔和的暖色。
飞剑上的剑修们纷纷倒吸一口凉气。有人甚至不自觉地走到了飞剑边缘，探身往下看，瞳孔中倒映着满目的红光。
“这……这似乎是极为稀有的红色仙晶。”一名年轻剑修喃喃道，好……好大的手笔。”
众人望着那片红色星环编织的瑰丽景象，目光中闪过一丝复杂的感慨，相比较之下，原始剑墟越发像是一个犄角疙瘩里面的穷地方，就连余烬也忍不住，多观察了几眼。
“我在来之前查阅了许多信息。”陈越忽然开口解释，声音不高不低，恰好让飞舟上所有人都能听见，“据说皇天宫为了这场大婚，提前多年便开始做准备。这些红色光环，全是用一种叫做‘赤霞仙晶’的珍稀材料炼制而成。那种仙晶只在南域极西的赤霞星渊中产出，产量极少，指甲盖大的一块就够一名神尊修炼十日，而皇天宫这次——”
他伸手指向那片连绵无尽的红色星海：“他们采光了整个赤霞星渊三成的矿脉，再将仙晶熔炼，掺入星核精金、混沌砂、九阳玄铁等等非凡材料，炼制成这数千道手臂通天的星界光环，每一座星界的星环都耗费了不下百万块赤霞仙晶。这些光环不止好看，每时每刻都在向星界灌注精纯的仙元之气，粗略估算，一座小星界有了这光环加持，一年内的仙元浓度至少能提升三成。”
飞剑上安静了一瞬。
三成，对于一座星界来说，这意味着什么？意味着灵药的生长周期缩短，修士突破瓶颈的几率提升，甚至整座星界的天地法则都会变得更活跃、更易于感悟。
“难怪都说皇天宫是南域第一富。”一个剑修忍不住嘀咕。
“富？”陈越笑了一声，“富只是最不值一提的东西。能做出这种手笔，至少说明大罗皇对那位皇妃极为看重，甚至远在常人想象之上。而能让一位主宰级强者如此看重的人，我更好奇到底地漂亮成什么样子？”
众人面面相觑，都从彼此眼中看到了同一种情绪——期待中夹杂着些许不安，皇天宫手臂越是通天对于他们这种新兴势力想获得认同的难度越大！
余烬一直没吭声，他站在飞剑的剑首上，双手抱臂，望着那片越来越近的红色星海，不知在想什么。小飞扬走到他旁边，仰头看了他一眼。
“师祖。”

“嗯？”
“我们要不要先去找一下，皇天宫那位瑶光元帅？”
余烬的目光从星海上收回来，低头看了徒弟一眼。那双眼睛里没什么特别的情绪，平淡得像在说今天天气不错。
“不用。”他随口应道，“别人未必还记得我们。”
content_en:
Time passes day by day.
It has been traveling in the void for more than two months.
The starlight in front began to take on a faint reddish hue.
The flying sword flew for another half day, and when it jumped out from a crack in the void, the front suddenly became clear.
Within the boundless starry sky, star realm groups stretch across the void. Countless stars gather into a dazzling sea of ​​light. In the center of the sea of ​​light, there is a huge galaxy circling and winding, like a silver-white dragon lying in the void.
And every tributary of the galaxy and the edge of every star realm are wrapped with a magnificent red halo!
The red was neither the red of flames nor the dark red of blood, but more like a brilliant red that was as clear as crystal and as bright as morning glow. Each halo circulates evenly around the star world, with fine golden lines flowing on its surface, like a living vein slowly pulsing!
Thousands of star realms, each one is surrounded by such a red ring. Looking from a distance, the entire sea of ​​​​stars seems to be woven with a huge red light network. Those haloes intersect and shine in the dark void, dyeing the tens of thousands of miles of void road with a soft and warm color.
The sword cultivators on the flying sword took a breath of cold air. Some people even unconsciously walked to the edge of the flying sword, leaned forward and looked down, with red light reflected in their pupils.
"This... this seems to be an extremely rare red fairy crystal." A young swordsman murmured, so... such a big deal. "
Everyone looked at the magnificent scene woven with red star rings, and complex emotions flashed in their eyes. In comparison, the original Sword Ruins looked more and more like a poor place inside a horn. Even Ember couldn't help but take a few more glances.
“I looked up a lot of information before coming here. "Chen Yue suddenly explained, his voice neither high nor low, just enough for everyone on the flying boat to hear, "It is said that Huangtian Palace started preparing for this wedding many years in advance. These red halos are all made from a rare material called 'Red Cloud Immortal Crystal'. That kind of immortal crystal is only produced in the Scarlet Cloud Star Abyss in the far west of the South Territory. The output is very small. A piece as big as a fingernail is enough for a god to practice for ten days, and this time in Huangtian Palace - "
He pointed at the endless sea of red stars: "They mined 30% of the ore veins of the entire Chixia Star Abyss, then smelted the fairy crystals, mixed them with extraordinary materials such as star core fine gold, chaos sand, Nine Yang Black Iron, etc., and refined them into thousands of star halos with arms reaching into the sky. Each star ring in the star world cost no less than a million pieces of Chixia fairy crystals. These halos are not only beautiful to look at, they are infusing pure immortal energy into the star realm every moment. It is roughly estimated that with the blessing of this halo, the concentration of immortal energy in a small star realm can be increased by at least 30% within a year. "
There was silence on Feijian for a moment.
Thirty percent, what does this mean for a star realm? This means that the growth cycle of elixirs is shortened, the chances of monks breaking through bottlenecks are increased, and even the laws of heaven and earth in the entire star realm will become more active and easier to comprehend.
“No wonder people say that Huangtian Palace is the richest man in the Southern Region. "A sword cultivator couldn't help but mutter.
"Rich? Chen Yue laughed, "Wealth is the least worth mentioning." Being able to do this kind of thing at least shows that Emperor Daluo values ​​the imperial concubine very much, even far beyond ordinary people's imagination. And for a person who can be so valued by a dominant powerhouse, I am even more curious about how beautiful he is? "
Everyone looked at each other and saw the same emotion in each other's eyes - anticipation mixed with a little uneasiness. The more the Emperor's arms reach the sky, the harder it will be for emerging forces like them to gain recognition!
Yi Yan remained silent. He stood on the head of the flying sword, folding his arms and looking at the sea of red stars that was getting closer and closer. He didn't know what he was thinking. Xiao Feiyang walked next to him and looked up at him.
"Master. "
"Um? "
"Should we go first?Let’s find out, Marshal Yaoguang from Huangtian Palace? "
Yi Yan withdrew his gaze from the sea of stars and glanced down at his apprentice. There was no special emotion in those eyes, they were as bland as saying that the weather is nice today.
"No need. He responded casually, "Others may not still remember us." "
